task.title: WidgetRegistry/Renderer/ChartRenderer
task.summary_zh: 依 A3 catalog/schemas 實作 Agora frontend WidgetRegistry/WidgetRenderer/ChartSpecRenderer；首發只渲染 registry active widgets，ChartSpec 對齊 A3 grammar，禁止任意 code。

(2) canonical services/control-plane/specs/agora/widget_spec.schema.json is the frozen AG-XR-001 old schema and there is no canonical chart_spec.schema.json or widget_registry.v1.json there; execute-plans generated snapshot still uses old widget_spec checksum, so A3 frontend/backend registry checksum consistency is not reproducible. (3) target files execute-plans/src/agora/widgets/registry.ts, WidgetRenderer.tsx, ChartSpecRenderer.tsx and widgets directory do not exist in this baseline; confirm whether AG-FE-DB-001 should create them and how to wire them without inventing UI/route/layout. (4) package.json has neither echarts nor recharts; confirm approved chart library/dependency and whether AG-BE-DB-001 must land first.
